data: The parent data register supplies the MS/DR scheme as labelled therein, one-TeV DR quark Yukawas and three CKM angles plus phase. Two-width marginal work boxes are used only where indicated.
orbifold: Zero Wilson lines and standard inversion lift j -> -j. Orthogonal bulk parity modes on the covering torus. No localized operators, kinetic terms or twisted states. Overall orbifold normalization cancels in normalized kernel and relative amplitude tests.
empirical_benchmark: N=5 even parity, both sectors use the same canonical zero modes, with independent allowed Higgs covectors and sector strengths. Distinguish fitted common left frame from external calibration of a heavy direction.
